name: Drawer · before 02 · Face ID
title: Do you want to allow “Mara Wallet” to use Face ID?

catalogue.note: Before, screen 2 of 8 (Figma layer “07”): sheet 339 tall. Drawn in Figma at 0.53 of real size (198.75×424; every instance carries scaleFactor 0.53 and the master component is 375 wide), built at 375×800 with every value divided by 0.53: 24/32/40 padding, 56 buttons, 16 radius, type 33/23/18/16/14. Square-cornered: the artboard’s 16px corners and its 1px #DDDDDD outline are left off, and the diff leaves that ring out. Figma snaps each text line to a whole pixel at its own small scale, so line heights are whole Figma pixels ÷ 0.53 (26.4 for 18px type, not 27), and it sets some baselines lower than a browser does: 23px titles and 14px medium text sit up to 2px lower in Figma, 18px text under 1px. They are left where the browser puts them. Box edges fall on fractions of a pixel, which Figma blurs over two rows and Chrome snaps to one. Satoshi 400/500/700/900 and Roboto 500 are embedded whole from files on this Mac. Icons are Figma’s SVG exports of the icon nodes. Flat fills match exactly. The file holds this sheet twice, a quarter-pixel apart; the upper copy is built, the lower kept only as its white shape. The scrim sits 0.36/0.14 off the frame, as drawn.
